entry.title: Mario Super Sluggers v1.0.0
entry.content:
- Code patches have been moved from being applied at runtime by the client to the new [**MSS AP Patcher**](<https://github.com/MarioManTAW/mss-ap-patcher/releases>). This should make the game more stable and less susceptible to issues when connection steps happen out of order. - This means that **patching is now mandatory**, be sure to follow the new setup steps. Additionally, this update is **not backwards-compatible** with older APWorld versions so please finish any ongoing multiworlds before updating. - New option: **Randomize Error Items**. Randomizes which 3 error items you have access to at the start. - New option: **Randomize Stats**. Shuffles stats between characters. Pitching, batting, fielding, and running stats are shuffled independently. - New option: **Randomize Puzzles**. Randomizes the lever puzzle in Mario Stadium and the hedge maze in Peach Ice Garden. - New option: **Randomize Quiz**. Adds additional question sets for Blue Yoshi's quiz, including sluggers, math, and meme. - New option: **Randomize Text**. Shuffles text/dialogue throughout the game, excluding relevant UI/tutorial text.
Check out the [setup guide](<https://github.com/MarioManTAW/Archipelago/blob/sluggers/worlds/mario_super_sluggers/docs/setup_en.md>) for setup procedures (this has changed!). You may also find the [PopTracker pack](<https://github.com/MarioManTAW/MarioSuperSluggersAPTracker/releases>) helpful.

entry.title: Tomba! v0.2.2b0
entry.content:
Second **beta release** introducing several new settings and a better location management that should hopefully results in less missing checks
> [!WARNING] > This release is in testing phase. While core progression mechanics are fully functional, you may encounter minor bugs or pacing quirks. Please report any logic errors or generation issues on the issue tracker.
---
## ✨ What's New
### 🛠️ Core Optimization & Stability * **Overhauled Location Tracking**: Rewrote location metadata to double-check in-game status directly instead of guessing. This drastically reduces missing checks. * **Performance Boost**: Enhanced overall responsiveness and speed of the new location/check system.
### 🗺️ Logic & Rule Fixes * **Expanded Item Pool**: Added all remaining chests containing AP Crystals or Apples to the randomized pool. * **Reachability Fixes**: Corrected rules for accessing locations via item combinations or specific conditions. * **Key Requirements**: Fixed several item locations that were mistakenly assigned the wrong required key. * **Jump Rule Update**: Updated the `CAN_BIG_JUMP` rule to correctly include **Psychic Fish** and **Blue Powder**. * **Missing Items**: Restored the 3 missing 1Ups from the *Million Year Old Chest* in **Familiar Mansion**. * **Typo Fixes**: Cleaned up minor text errors.
### 🐛 Bug Fixes * Fix #26 * Fix #45 * Fix #46 * Fix #48 * Fix #49 * Fix #50 * Fix #51 * Fix #52 * Fix #53 * Fix #54 * Fix #56 * Fix #59 * Fix #64
---
## 🔧 Installation 1. Download the source code or the `.apworld` file. 2. Drop it into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` directory.

entry.title: The Legend of Zelda - Spirit Tracks v0.8.0
entry.content:
Very not compatible with previous versions. Requires new minimum Archipelago version of v0.6.7
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/DayKat/spirit-tracks/blob/main/worlds/tloz_st/docs/setup.md)
## UT Map Tracker by @Catzador and me - Maps for every room in the game, with entrances, locations, events and auto tabbing!
## Randomized Start - Added Randomized Start - Has presets for niko, stations, towns and tos, but you can add any land entrance you like to the pool - Added free_starting_items option, cause most stations have no locations on an empty sphere 0. - start_with_train does a bit of railfinding, and will give you valid rails if your starting entrance leads to a train entrance.
## Entrance Randomization - Added entrance rando with the following groupings, that can either be shuffled by themselves or in 1 of 3 pools with other grouping. Dungeon options can also choose to only be shuffle with dungeon parts of the same dungeon: - shuffle_houses - shuffle_caves - shuffle_overworld_transitions - shuffle_stations - shuffle_train_transitions - shuffle_portals - shuffle_dungeon_entrances - shuffle_bosses - shuffle_dungeon_rooms - shuffle_blue_warps - shuffle_tos_staircase - shuffle_tos_entrances (not new, but has the new pool options) - shuffle_hyrule_castle - shuffle_disorientation (>:3) - shuffle_eote (ends of the earth) - shuffle_las (lost at sea) - Added the following entrance randomizer modifier options: - entrance_directionality: choose what pools and groupings care about pairing ups and downs etc. - decouple_entrances - ut_blocked_entrances: same as ph, choose how ut tracks blocked entrances. - Added entrance plando, with auto-pairing of orphaned entrances across groupings. - Adding option for changing the number of times ER tries to generate a valid layout, in case you want to play with volitile ER settings. - Added extended hint data when entrances are randomized
## Smaller new stuff - Added in-game warp to start! Same as ph, open the collection screen and flip to prime, then enter any transition or save and quit! - Added map warp! Tap a station on the map to prime a warp there. UT's `/get_logical_path` considers map warp when finding the shortest path. This can be disabled in host.yaml. - You remain in control during cutscenes for opening doors, extending bridges and hitting switches! - Added an option for non-progressive versions of bombs, bow and sword - Phantom Zelda now teleports to you whenever you try to enter a door without her - Added 3 missing big rupee locations in Dune Sanctuary - Added the /count_entrances client command, to check your entrance exploration progress. - Added an `all` option to plando_dungeon_pool - Opened the one-way passage from tunnel to the tower to the tower basement - Removed dungeons automatically open their boss doors, and give free small keys (in case ER wants you to pass through or something) - Locations sent from console now process in client, for things like sending ut events - Added open_blizzard_temple yaml option, the bell doors are always open - Added open_blue_warps yaml option, 2-way blue warps are always open - New UT events: - Unlocking blue warps - Unlocking train portals - Delivering NPCs that give rewards in other rooms to their stations. - Visiting Kagoron at the Mountain Altar - Finding the chest at Disorientation Station - Triggers in other ER rooms in marine temple - Unique rabbit locations when total rabbits are enabled - Stamp stations with vanilla stamps - Extra shortcuts - Added a yaml option to toggle extra UT events - UT's /get_logical_path can use unlocked shortcuts. - Many events will trigger backup activation of themselves if save data was lost after triggering them
## Bugfixes and tweaks - Fixed crashes from game trying to spawn demon trains on non-existant tracks. Forest glyph is now randomizable, as well as fire glyph without btt - Fixed gen bug where certain locations required a `player` amount of something - `both` option for dark realm access now cares about dungeons - Shattered compass mode no longer adds a completed compass to the pool - Boss key stuff should no longer crash! - Fraaz can now logically be killed with more than sword (most weapons hit through his big form's chargeup!) - Oops some events did not have data. - no_cargo now removes all lava in Goron Village - Ferrus now spawns in fire realm with ocean source - Hearts no longer get stolen at max health - Farmabe chests in LAS give treasure on repeat visits. final chest does not when rooms are shuffled - Quitting on the train no longer sends rabbit locations - Fixed catch 50 rabbits location - Fixed Linebeck treasure cave giving free rupees - Fixed Cactops giving free ocean source - Train parts are more consistent - Teao 3 unlocks without the previous levels if Teao 3 is a required dungeon - Fixed Teao 3 location - Stamps gotten with the vanilla stamp option persist through resets - Fixed item models for farmable chests on repeat visits - Client now actually fetches most server data on connecting rather than needing to wait until they get updated lol - Added a 10s timeout for precision operations - Saving and quitting was triggering events early, fixed it - Renamed starting entrance to Warp to Start - Prevented deathlink from processing during get item cutscenes - Fixed compass of light appearing in pool when playing with shattered compass - Failing to enter the dark realm sends goal requirement info - Added getting ToS 19f center chest without rotating repeaters with an off screen bow shot - Fixed model swaps for progressive item vanilla locations - Made progress on multi-version support - Sending extra progressive items sets the base item
Huge thanks to @catzador for doing tracker data entry and loads of playtesting before release!

entry.title: Mega Man Zero 3 v0.3.0
entry.content:
A full rewrite! The world is now [built from a decompilation of the game](https://github.com/mmzret/rmz3) instead of patched into the ROM by hand.
Since this update is almost a total rewrite, so there could likely be a lot of undocumented bugs, so be sure to let me know in the Discord if anything seems off!
# New Features: - Item popups. You now get a little graphic on screen when another player sends you an item. - This is still a work in progress, as the icons currently don't actually represent what you've received. - There is now a disk counter on the pause menu, so you can see how many you're holding out of how many you need for your goal to complete. - The hub room lets you replay a stage you've already cleared, either as a free run or as the mission again. This lets you reattempt missions for another chance at an A+ rank clear, meaning that no checks in this world are missable. - The vanilla goal option has been removed. There used to be a "vanilla" option, where you just had to beat the final boss. It has been removed, and now the only goal is to beat the boss with the set number of secret disks given. If you want the old way back, you can just set required disks to 0. I didn't feel like maintaining both options, and I don't think many people used it anyway. # Bug Fixes - E-Crystals filler items should no longer be lost if you load earlier saves after being sent them. - Subtanks no longer delete their location check. Receiving a subtank from someone else used to despawn its pickup in the world, which made that location impossible to get. - Armor chips, subtanks, and crystals no longer get temporarily deleted by a game over, and now show up immediately when you load a save. - Fixed one of Sunken Library's disks not being reset when you load the level and have already been given the disk through an Archipelago item. - Removed the warning telling you not to save after the credits. New Game Plus works entirely now, and saving whenever should be fine too, but you should probably keep a save game on the last level just so you can revisit all levels in the game.

entry.title: Rogue Legacy 2 v0.1.0r2
entry.content:
Note: Please replace both the .apworld and the game mod files when updating to this version
### Improvements
- Add a colored tree which displays the upgrade paths in the manor. Manor locations are now named according to this tree (i.e. Manor - Red Path Upgrade 3) so that it is much clearer what a hint (or spoiler log) is referring to in the manor. - This can be toggled on/off using the Spin-Kick button - Added flavor text for foreign item descriptions which indicates whether it is progression, useful, or filler (or trap). - Manor items are no longer all marked as progression, only stat upgrades (assuming the YAML is configured to require some number of stat upgrades before biomes/bosses are considered "in-logic") are now progression. Things like class unlocks are not. This should provide a marginal improvement in success rate when generating worlds with stringent logic.
### New Config Options
1. reveal_manor_upgrades - (true/false, default: false), When enabled, all upgrades in the manor will be shown so purchases can be planned in advance. The normal purchase gating still applies; before you can purchase an upgrade, you must have purchased the previous upgrade in the manor. 2. trap_appearance - (hidden/visible, default: hidden), When 'hidden' traps are disguised as another item from the multi-world so that they can't be trivially avoided by looking at an item name before purchasing. After purchase, the trap's true name is revealed.
### Bugfixes
- Fixed a bug where in a specific scenario (all estuaries defeated and sun lantern received already) Johan would not spawn in Pishon Dry Lake to give the sun-lantern-conversation location check.

entry.title: Look Outside v1.2.2
entry.content:
# QOL Features - Sybil’s Planetarium is unlocked by default - The book of crossword puzzles now starts with every puzzle completed but one - Paying rent now automatically grants locations for items that would otherwise become unreachable in the next phase of the landlord’s apartment - Removed some metadata from the client zipfile (.DS_Store artifacts from MacOS still present in some folders atm) - New options - Starting Roommates: Player can pick an amount of random recruits to be in their apartment from game start. - Elevator by Floor: When set to true, elevator activation will be granted one floor at a time, rather than all at once.
# Client fixes - Fixed bug where buying Item 6 from Mutt’s shop would send the location for buying Item 12 - Fixed bug where the boss Obsession was prevented from spawning in the Apartment 12 walls - Fixed bug where death link chat message would be sent on death even if death link was disabled - Fixed bug where the “Ease Regrets” option for Spine on the calendar in the player’s bedroom would not bring her back to life. - Fixed bug where being too late to save Ernest would not cause his ease regrets option to appear - Fixed bug where disabling randomized game skills still removes games’ ability to grant skills - Fixed bug where Wriggly Fred vanishes from the Fred apartment when acquired in the player’s fridge through the randomizer. - Fixed issue where "Suturing Kit" uses were initialized when defeating Taxidermy instead of when acquiring the item - Sam will now have arms until first connecting to archipelago to avoid a bug where the starting cutscene could remove arms after they had been granted to the player by archipelago. - Fixed some missing or swapped item icons - If player missed picking up the item randomized to the "Fred's Apt. Hat Room - Item" location before killing Toxic/Green Fred, then killing “Not A Cowboy Hat” will grant the location instead
# Apworld changes - Fixed logic bug where “Teddy” was not considered a requirement for “Apt. 32 Bathroom - Item From Joel (Day 2-5)” - Fixed logic bug where “Myrmidon XII” was not considered a requirement for “Play Video Game - Myrmidon XII” - Fixed logic bug where “Rat Baby Thing” was not considered a requirement for “Apt. 13 - Item From Wall Mouth” - Fixed logic bug where certain worm enemies were considered reachable without completing Nestor and Rafta’s quest (nor were disabled when when Nestor and Rafta’s quest locations were disabled) - Fixed logic bug where Kevin shop item locations were considered reachable without completing Nestor and Rafta’s quest (nor were disabled when when Nestor and Rafta’s quest locations were disabled) - “Worm Egg” is no longer added to the item pool when Nestor and Rafta’s quest locations are disabled - Fixed logic bug where offerings were not considered a requirement for “Pre-ritual Gift From Jasper” (now requires 4 offerings or 3 offerings + Guinea Pig) - Disabling game skills now makes most games not progression items - Adjusted item pool drop rates of some filler items - Adjusted some location names
## Difficulty bugs - Fixed bug where extra enemies that only appear in certain difficulties no longer appear in the overworld in all difficulties (this only applies to enemies that are bundled into fights that appear in all difficulties; hard-mode exclusive enemies like the Tooth Fairy in the tooth apartment will still always appear) - Vincent’s apartment is no longer open by default on non-Cursed difficulties, to align better with vanilla behavior - Fixed errors where the following overworld item locations would not appear on all difficulty modes: - Boiler Storage - Item on South Table 1 - Boiler Storage - Item on South Table 3 - Boiler Storage - Item on West Counter 2 - Security Storage - Item on North Counter 2 - LL Memorial Room Cache - West Table Item 2 - LL Memorial Room Cache - South Corner Item 1 - Laundromat - Item in Southeast Corner - Mutt's Shop Bathroom - Item on Counter
